# ex: matchSelectorExpr with method value and method expression
ex {
	var t T
	t.Do -> t.Do2
}
-- x.go --
package p

type T struct{}

func (T) Do()  {}
func (T) Do2() {}

func f() {
	var v T
	// method value - should match
	fn := v.Do
	_ = fn
	// method expression - should not match (type vs value)
	fn2 := T.Do
	_ = fn2
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -8,7 +8,7 @@
 func f() {
 	var v T
 	// method value - should match
-	fn := v.Do
+	fn := v.Do2
 	_ = fn
 	// method expression - should not match (type vs value)
 	fn2 := T.Do
